Superior-Union

DOCKET NO. F01303825
PLAINTIFF – METROPOLITAN LIFE INSURANCE COMPANY
DEFENDANTS- LENY EXUMA; MRS/MR. EXUMA, SPOUSE OR CIVIL UNION PARTNER OF LENY EXUMA; SUSERNE EXUMA; MR./MRS. EXUMA, SPOUSE OR CIVIL UNION PARTNER OF SUSERNE EXUMA; STATE OF NEW JERSEY; TOWNSHIP OF UNION
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public venue on
Wednesday THE 1st DAY OF July 2026
between the hours of two and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 2:00 P.M. prevailing time at Warinanco Ice Skating Center, 1 Park Drive, Roselle, New Jersey 07203 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the town of UNION, County of Union and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: LOT 9 BLOCK 206
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
736 VIVIAN TERRACE UNION, NJ
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Union County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes: All that certain land and premises situated in the Township of Union, County of Union, State of New Jersey, being more particularly described as follows:
Property Occupancy: Owner Occupied on the Tax Map of the Township of Union
Nearest Cross Street: Approximately 55.12ft to the Nearest Cross Street known as Springfield Road
Approximate Dimensions: 100.00ft x 60.00ft x 100.00ft x 60.00ft
The full legal description can be found in the Office of the Clerk of Union County in Deed Book 5003, at Page 353
APPROXIMATE UPSET AMOUNT IS $288,547.29 FOR THE SHERIFF SALE
Pursuant to a municipal tax search dated May 14, 2026.
Subject to: 2026 3rd quarter taxes due 8/1/2026, TO BE DETERMINED
2026 4th quarter taxes due 11/1/2026, To BE DETERMINED
Sewer: Acct. 161-0, To: 5/14/2026, $488.16 OPEN
THE SHERIFF HEREBY RESERVES THE RIGHT TO ADJOURN THIS SALE WITHOUT FURTHER NOTICE THROUGH PUBLICATION
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court
4914-9936-6555, v.
WALLACK LLP
ATTORNEYS AT LAW
Page 3
Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding surplus, if any.
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Union County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $261,901.28 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Peter D. Corvelli
SHERIFF

HILL WALLACK LLP
